content: Every comic strip has an evolutionary arc. Every cartoonist changes their style over time as they hone their craft, develop their sense of humor shifts, master their particular style, and/or pander to their audience. Sometimes an early character may all but disappear from the comic, or some incidental member of the cast may take up the spotlight. It's part of the fun of going on archive binges, whether it's old newspaper comics or long-running web series. Comics are living things, and few of them stay in the places where they started.
